entities.summary: The Birthplace of Frédéric Chopin is a dworek surrounded by a large natural park at the banks of Utrata River in Żelazowa Wola near Sochaczew in Poland – presently a biographical museum of the composer, department of the Fryderyk Chopin Museum in Warsaw.
